name: rewind
rule: rewind keeps the same Claude native session, like the CLI's /rewind; adopt upstream types around it

origin_commits.subject: feat(chat): /rewind and /config menus for Claude on desktop and phone (WCC-127)
fix(server): Claude rewind admits a fork that dropped an early message after a compaction summary (WCC-127)

cases: refuses an unknown native message without forking or restarting
a later turn-count rollback cuts at the right message
unknown markers stay unknown, so a later turn-count rollback refuses
refuses a message it cannot line up with the saved markers
rewinds again and again in the same native session
rewinds a compacted session in place and keeps its markers
rewinds to the first message by resuming the same session where it hangs
refuses a first-message rewind when nothing precedes it and keeps the session
keeps the cut through a restart until the next reply commits it
conversation rewind preserves earlier history with zero checkpoint counts
conversation rewind keeps message-less turn work recorded before it
sends exact-message rewind through a command older hosts cannot mistake for file restore
keeps work from message-less turns recorded before the rewind boundary
retains explicit earlier messages without file checkpoints
recognizes only whole commands, not requests mentioning commands
uses absolute checkpoint counts, never the index of a paginated message
offers Claude client menus once, only in an existing thread
